title: Relationships: Multi-axis model (trust, attraction, fear, resentment) and asymmetric stance
goal: Replace flat single-scalar closeness with multi-axis, asymmetric relationship state

sections.what: Expand player.relationships[other] beyond a single closeness scalar to support trust, attraction, fear, and resentment.
sections.why: Characters currently smuggle #trust:5 and #attraction:4 into memory tags because closeness alone cannot express fear, distrust, or asymmetric feelings.
sections.how: Extend relationship records with optional/defaulted trust, attraction, fear, and resentment dimensions in engine/relationships.py, migrate/hydrate cleanly, and render in Mind -> People and prompts.

acceptance.text: engine/relationships.py supports trust, attraction, fear, and resentment axes alongside closeness
Serialization, scenario load/save, and library diff preserve multi-axis relationship records backward-compatibly
Mind -> People and Commons/agent prompts surface relationship axes without requiring #trust/#attraction memory tag hacks

custom.browser_ui: Mind -> People and character inspector show trust, attraction, fear, and resentment bars/values alongside closeness and label.
